I have manure from our livestock, so I will use that to keep the soil fertile, but chemical fertilizer is too costly and difficult to buy for just this tiny piece of land. I will plant seeds I saved from last season, and since the plot is so small, my family can do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without paying for hired help.
